Municipal garden publication names Bugatti's Colosse. Preserve the posthumous cast distinction: composition1907; Gravelines bronze cast1990 according to the documented plaque transcription, C. Valsuani. Do not describe this physical bronze as a lifetime1907 cast. Preserve the entire figure, rock, feet, base and visible cast supports. Exact digital scale unverified. The municipal publication names La Liberté and La Méditation by Magda (printed Memeth). Actually matched Pierre Doyen's on-site physical photograph to source image: face and swept hair, breast/torso, raised head, hands behind and folded knees/feet. The plinth bears Liberté1991 and Magda Nemeth. Bronze figure on a substantial marble pedestal; documentary total height~1.8m is provider-reported, never digital calibration. Artist birthdate from provider is not independently established and should be omitted. Artwork copyright and the CC BY4 scan license are separate.
